#2. Suppose the odd prime (3,5,7,11,13, 17.... in order of increasing size are P1, P2, P3
PiPi+1 +2 is prime, for all /≥ 1.
...Prove or disprove:
Solution:
We begin by trying a few cases. Hopefully we will either get an idea of how to prove the result, or we will find a
counterexample.
3-5+2=17
5-7+2=37
7-11+2=79
11-13+2=145.
We stop here because 145 is not prime. The number 145 is a counterexample. Therefore the original statement is false.
Prof. Eunwoo 10m (Chung-Ang University)
